def _consensus(x, y, prior):
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    good = np.abs(x[j] - x[i]) >= 0.05
    i, j = (i[good], j[good])
    g = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    b = y[i] - g * x[i]
    lines = np.vstack((prior, np.column_stack((g[g > 0], b[g > 0]))))
    errors = np.abs(lines[:, :1] * x + lines[:, 1:] - y)
    clean = errors < 0.001
    counts = clean.sum(axis=1)
    cost = np.linalg.norm((lines - prior) * [max(1.0, np.ptp(x)) if len(x) else 1.0, 1.0], axis=1)
    best = np.lexsort((cost, -counts))[0]
    mask = clean[best]
    if counts[best] >= max(3, len(x) // 2 + 1) and np.ptp(x[mask]) >= 0.1:
        return (np.polyfit(x[mask], y[mask], 1), True)
    return (lines[best], False)

def _alignment(train, test):
    labs = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    strata = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    refs = np.vstack((train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']))
    raw = np.vstack((train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw'])).astype(float)
    for lab in np.unique(labs):
        mask = labs == lab
        panel = refs[mask]
        panel = panel[:, np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        if panel.shape[1]:
            center = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
            scale = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
            raw[mask] = (raw[mask] - center) / (scale if scale > 0 else 1.0)
    _, cells = np.unique(np.column_stack((labs, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    finite = np.isfinite(raw)
    counts = np.zeros((cells.max() + 1, raw.shape[1]))
    sums = np.zeros_like(counts)
    np.add.at(counts, cells, finite)
    np.add.at(sums, cells, np.where(finite, raw, 0.0))
    means = np.divide(sums, counts, out=np.zeros_like(sums), where=counts > 0)
    fill = means.sum(axis=0) / np.maximum(1, (counts > 0).sum(axis=0))
    aligned = np.where(finite, raw, fill)
    return np.split(aligned, [len(train['lab_id'])])

def _inputs(block, aligned, maps, dt, yield_stress):
    gain, bias = maps[np.asarray(block['lab_id'], int)].T
    hist = block['past_stress_cmd'] * gain[:, None] + bias[:, None]
    hold = block['stress_hold_cmd'] * gain + bias
    ov_hold = np.maximum(np.abs(hold) - yield_stress, 0.0) ** 2 * np.sign(hold)
    work_hold = np.maximum(np.abs(hist) - yield_stress, 0.0) ** 2 @ dt * hold
    return (hist, hold, np.column_stack((np.ones(len(hold)), aligned)), ov_hold, work_hold)

def _design(taus, inputs, dt, time):
    hist, hold, cov, ov_hold, work_hold = inputs
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    memory = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / taus) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus)
    jump = hold[:, None] - np.einsum('ij,jk->ik', hist, memory)
    decay = -np.expm1(-time[:, None] / taus)
    curves = np.concatenate((jump[:, None, :] * decay, cov[:, None, :] * time[None, :, None], (ov_hold[:, None] * time)[:, :, None], (work_hold[:, None] * decay[:, 0])[:, :, None]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((jump / taus, cov, ov_hold, work_hold / taus[0]))
    return (curves, rate)

def _fit(train, inputs, dt, time):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    from scipy.linalg import lstsq
    eps = train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None]
    y = np.r_[eps.ravel(), train['instant_rate_obs']]
    use = np.r_[np.ones(7, dtype=bool), [np.any(v) for v in inputs[-2:]]]

    def unpack(q):
        t1 = np.exp(q[0])
        return np.array([t1, t1 + (24.99 - t1) * q[1]])

    def design(q):
        curve, rate = _design(unpack(q), inputs, dt, time)
        return np.vstack((curve.reshape(-1, 9), rate))[:, use]

    def project(q):
        a = design(q)
        w = lstsq(a, y, lapack_driver='gelsy')[0]
        return (a * w).sum(axis=1) - y
    lo, hi = ([np.log(0.05001), 1e-05], [np.log(24.98), 1.0])
    fits = [least_squares(project, [np.log(a), (b - a) / (24.99 - a)], bounds=(lo, hi), loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.05, max_nfev=60) for a, b in ((0.27, 1.4), (0.55, 4.0), (1.2, 8.0))]
    q = min(fits, key=lambda result: result.cost).x
    p = np.r_[q, lstsq(design(q), y, lapack_driver='gelsy')[0]]
    bounds = (np.r_[lo, np.full(use.sum(), -np.inf)], np.r_[hi, np.full(use.sum(), np.inf)])

    def residual(p):
        return (design(p[:2]) * p[2:]).sum(axis=1) - y

    def channel_scales(e):
        curves = e[:eps.size].reshape(eps.shape)
        rates = e[eps.size:]

        def mad(a, axis):
            center = np.median(a, axis=axis, keepdims=True)
            return np.maximum(1e-07, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(a - center), axis=axis))
        return np.r_[np.tile(mad(curves, 0), len(eps)), np.full(len(rates), mad(rates, 0))]
    for _ in range(2):
        scale = channel_scales(residual(p))
        p = least_squares(lambda v: residual(v) / (2.5 * scale), p, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', max_nfev=80).x
    scale = channel_scales(residual(p))
    keep = np.abs(residual(p)) < 6.0 * scale
    p = least_squares(lambda v: (residual(v) / scale)[keep], p, bounds=bounds, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=3.0, max_nfev=60).x
    w = np.zeros(9)
    w[use] = p[2:]
    return (unpack(p[:2]), w)

def _crossing(time, initial, strain, critical):
    grid = np.r_[0.0, time]
    distance = np.column_stack((initial, strain)) - critical[:, None]
    reached = distance >= 0
    first = np.argmax(reached, axis=1)
    crossing = np.full(len(initial), time[-1])
    crossing[reached[:, 0]] = 0.0
    i = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    j = first[i]
    before, after = (distance[i, j - 1], distance[i, j])
    crossing[i] = grid[j - 1] - before / (after - before) * (grid[j] - grid[j - 1])
    return crossing
